source_snapshot.test_name_items: AC Power Cycle (via PDU) ( with revise MAC address)
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Before run AC cycle,  revise BMC and others eth MAC address
1. Eth MAC command:
ifconfig <device port> down
ifconfig <device port>  hw ether XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX
ifconfig <device port>  up

2. BMC MAC command:
ipmitool raw 0x30 0x40 0x0
ipmitool lan set 0x01 macaddr XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX
ex.
ipmitool lan set 0x01 macaddr 70:e2:84:3a:65:10

AC:
check all of devices in each cycle time.
1. Set node power policy for "Always-On".
2. SUT records the information of "lspci -vv" when booting into OS.
3. After lspci information recorded, shutdown SUT.
4. Turn off chassis AC power via Cyber Switch.
5. Wait for 30 seconds and AC on.
6. Wait for the time that SUT should boot into OS for recording lspci information and shutdown (For example, 600 seconds).
7. Repeat step 2 to step 6 long term.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. SUT should not hang during AC cycle.
2. Information of "lspci", "lsblk", "nvme" commands should not have any change during AC cycle.
3. SUT should be workable after AC cycle stress.
4. BMC FRU and SDR information for each cycle should be correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Automates inventories but leaves PDU AC actions to an operator.
deepseek_columns.risk: Dedicated SUT and controlled PDU required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; captures OS inventory but omits safe MAC mutation/rollback, FRU/SDR evidence and bounded stop logic.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; treats PDU action as operator-controlled and adds MAC, BMC and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; PDU and destructive power risk noted.

original_test_intent: Validate repeated PDU-controlled AC removal and Always-On recovery after authorized OS and BMC MAC revisions, with stable PCIe/storage inventory, correct BMC FRU/SDR, no hang and final host usability.
original_method: Physically establish and verify a dedicated Cyber Switch/PDU outlet and isolated MAC plan, validate vendor-specific BMC mutation/rollback, then automate each graceful shutdown, 30-second AC-off/on interval, bounded OS return, inventories, FRU/SDR/SEL comparison and stop-on-drift.
manual_activity: An engineer must physically establish/verify the dedicated PDU-to-SUT mapping and approve unique MAC identities. Once that environment exists, an approved PDU API/project cycle script may automate the core loop; this is not Seq 182 and does not require manual cable removal.
required_inputs: Dedicated SUT, exact Cyber Switch/PDU model/outlet mapping, supported control package and independent OOB access
Authoritative current/new OS and BMC MAC values, uniqueness/isolation proof and rollback plan
Vendor confirmation for `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x40 0x0`, LAN channel 0x01 and persistence semantics
Cycle count, 30-second off interval, 600-second example boot timeout and Always-On policy
Approved lspci/lsblk/nvme plus FRU/SDR baselines and stop rules
safety_requirements: Never use the illustrative 70:e2:84:3a:65:10 or mutate a shared/production identity; verify uniqueness and recovery first.
Confirm graceful shutdown and the exact dedicated outlet before each cut; independently verify off/on state and bounded readiness.
Stop on ambiguous PDU state, failed shutdown, boot timeout, MAC conflict, inventory/FRU/SDR drift or new critical SEL/OS event.
No automatic retry, outlet guessing, alternate raw command, repeated power cut after failure or hidden failed cycle.
Preserve per-cycle evidence and restore only the approved network/power state.
agent_execution_scope: After physical mapping/setup, validate PDU API, MAC plan, vendor syntax, baselines and recovery gates.
Use the approved PA Manager Cycle/project script to orchestrate fixed cycles and collect OS/BMC/PDU evidence.
Stop on first unsafe/failing condition, preserve raw history and report Tool Result only.
engineer_actions: Physically verify outlet/cabling and approve the dedicated maintenance window and MAC plan.
Approve vendor-specific mutation/rollback, cycle parameters and recovery; intervene if reachability is lost.
Review all cycle diffs and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its inventory-only SSH command does not implement source MAC changes, Always-On policy, graceful shutdown, AC timing, FRU/SDR or full loop coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve every source command but execute MAC/IPMI raw operations only after platform validation; prefer the existing approved cycle/PDU integration for orchestration rather than inventing a vendor API.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: MAC placeholders/example, raw/LAN commands, Always-On, 30-second off, 600-second example boot wait, long-term loop, criteria, bundle and 30/1500-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: PDU-AUTOMATABLE AFTER PHYSICAL MAPPING AND VENDOR VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind immutable SUT/BMC/outlet identities, validate supported PDU and BMC APIs, create a transaction ledger for MAC mutation and every cycle, and use stop-on-drift comparisons with independent OOB recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Dedicated SUTs connected to an approved remotely controllable PDU/Cyber Switch with supported BMC commands.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PDU model/firmware/API, BMC model/firmware/IPMI behavior, OS/kernel, pciutils, util-linux, nvme-cli and cycle-script version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PDU and BMC/IPMI documentation plus the approved PA Manager Cycle/project script; no generic replacement command is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable outlet identity, MAC uniqueness/rollback, full BMC evidence and deterministic stop/recovery while retaining actual PDU AC cycling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; BMC/software reboot is not accepted as AC removal.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PDU control cannot be automated safely until physical outlet mapping is verified; raw IPMI semantics are vendor-specific.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve cycle count, boot timeout, inventory normalization and MAC targets. Report actual counts/values; a reduced plan does not claim the source long-term duration or original parameters were completed.
expected_evidence: Physical SUT/BMC/outlet mapping, PDU/BMC versions, dedicated-use approval, MAC uniqueness and rollback record
Pre-change and post-change OS/BMC MAC evidence and Always-On policy
Per-cycle shutdown, PDU off/on, 30-second interval, bounded readiness and return codes
Per-cycle lspci -vv, lsblk, nvme, FRU, SDR, SEL and normalized diffs
Final usability/network state, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires PDU AC cycling and MAC revision. The example address is clearly illustrative, while absent project values and acceptance for MAC persistence are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear. Missing PDU mapping, MAC values, package or cycle parameters are setup/readiness needs, not permanent semantic blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Expands inventory-only assistance to the full source loop, MAC/BMC evidence and safe PDU automation after physical setup.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its critical safety controls but recognizes that operator action for every cycle is not intrinsic when an approved PDU API exists.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies case-specific Seq 182 boundary: this explicit PDU case remains PARTIAL/setup-gated, not MANUAL ONLY.

review_improvement: Preserves the distinguishing MAC-revision and BMC FRU/SDR requirements and defines when real AC cycling may be automated without substituting BMC power-off or reboot.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical outlet mapping and network identity approval are necessary manual setup, while the subsequent PDU loop and evidence are automatable. Therefore the formal JSON class is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, not MANUAL ONLY and not FULLY AUTOMATABLE.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: Do not reissue MAC mutation, retry a failed PDU action, power-cycle after an inventory/boot fault, select another outlet or silently continue the loop.
